params.name: subdomain
params.description: Used to scope the request to the specified institution

params.name: location_id
params.description: Used to scope the request to the specified location

params.name: sort
params.description:
Optional comma-separated string of fields to sort on.
Include a leading dash for descending order.

Available fields:
  * updated_at
  * -updated_at

params.name: patient_id
params.description: The ID of the patient associated with the claim

params.name: guarantor_id
params.description: The ID of the guarantor associated with the claim

params.name: provider_id
params.description: The ID of the provider associated with the claim

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Claims updated at or after the specified time (UTC). The comparison is inclusive, so a record whose updated_at exactly equals the given value is returned

params.name: date_of_service
params.description: Claims whose date of service exactly matches the specified date

params.name: include_deleted
params.description: Include soft-deleted claims in the results

params.name: start_cursor
params.description: First item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: end_cursor
params.description: Last item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results to return per page. Maximum allowed amount is 1000.

items.docs: This endpoint returns a list of insurance claims for a location. You can filter by patient_id, guarantor_id, provider_id, updated_since or date_of_service, and must provide at least one of these filters. location_id is always required, but does not satisfy the at-least-one-filter requirement on its own. Soft-deleted claims are excluded unless include_deleted is true.

params.name: subdomain
params.description: Used to scope the request to the specified institution

params.name: include[]
params.description: Resources to be included in the response

items.docs: This endpoint returns a single insurance claim by its NexHealth id. Use the include parameter to embed related resources: patient, provider, guarantor, charges and/or charge_payouts. Note: when no claim with the given id exists, or it belongs to a location your token cannot access, this endpoint currently responds with HTTP 500 rather than a 404.
